text:
If you’re heading out for sunset, you should get some breaks in the clouds before 6:25, but don’t mistake the clearing for calm. Northwest winds stay brisk tonight, with the lake running 15 to 20 knots and waves around 2 to 4 feet, so the waterfront will feel colder than the upper 50s we managed today. Skies turn partly cloudy, temperatures slide to around 39, and the dry air will make it feel like a proper October night.

Tuesday looks brighter and chilly, with full sunshine and a high near 55. The models split a bit on the afternoon temperature, from the low 50s to the mid 50s, so I’d plan for the cooler side, especially with another northwest breeze around 13 mph. Good evening for a short waterfront walk, but bring a jacket and stay off the broad lake tonight.
